name: Hatoba College
description: Hatoba College is a serif editorial theme for a maritime training college founded in 1987 at Pier 3, Port Ellery. The front page opens with a framed harbour photograph under a centred header, with a docked navy caption bar, a white pager notch and a twelve-week tick line, then follows the course through enlarged-initial section words, five stacked stage bars and a brass Berth confirmed pill with three large dates. A parallax quay band, a three-ratio photo trio, a programme ledger, one cadet story, the journal and a newsletter band complete the page. Newsreader for headings, Source Serif 4 for reading, Noto Serif TC and JP for Chinese and Japanese. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: display: the home headline, section words, stage titles, dates, figures and the wordmark (variable 400 to 600, Latin subset, with italic)
text: body copy, navigation, labels, captions (variable 400 to 700, Latin subset, with italic)
display for Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) pages: headings and the wordmark (Regular 400, subset to the zh-TW sample text; never a Japanese font)
